purpleToYellowTwoInterchangesRule.appliesTo: All journeys between Purple Line (Whitefield to Challaghatta) and Yellow Line (RV Road to Bommasandra)
purpleToYellowTwoInterchangesRule.firstInterchange: Nadaprabhu Kempegowda Station, Majestic (Purple Line ⇄ Green Line)
purpleToYellowTwoInterchangesRule.secondInterchange: Rashtreeya Vidyalaya Road / RV Road (Green Line ⇄ Yellow Line)
purpleToYellowTwoInterchangesRule.explanation: Because the Purple and Yellow Lines do not intersect directly, all Purple-to-Yellow journeys require TWO interchanges via the central Green Line corridor.

standardRoutingStepByStep.action: Board train on Purple Line towards Nadaprabhu Kempegowda Station, Majestic.
INTERCHANGE 1: Alight at Majestic. Transfer from Purple Line underground concourse to Green Line Platform 4 (Southbound towards Silk Institute). Transfer time: ~5 minutes.
Ride Green Line train for 7 stations south (Chickpete → KR Market → National College → Lalbagh → South End Circle → Jayanagar → RV Road).
INTERCHANGE 2: Alight at RV Road. Transfer across the concourse to Yellow Line Platform 3 (Southbound towards Delta Electronics Bommasandra). Transfer time: ~3 minutes.
Ride Yellow Line train directly to your destination station (BTM Layout, Central Silk Board, Electronic City, Bommasandra).
